synopsis: Machine Control System Safety Analysis (MCSSA) is the method defined in ISO 19014-1, which also defines the methodology for required performance levels [f9775, f15572]. MCSSA is not a South African body [f15572]. The program should have an approved MCSSA before the prototype arrives, covering failure to intervene, incorrect intervention, allocated performance levels, and traceability from each requirement to its test [f12006]. This is a planning recommendation; the supplied facts do not establish whether approval has occurred or give a prototype arrival date [f12006].

relations.note: Both identify MCSSA as a method defined in ISO 19014-1.
Adds recommended approval timing, failure coverage, performance-level allocation, and requirement-to-test traceability.
